Synopsis:
Fanatic goblin who is building a shrine to the Absolute in your camp.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_Goblin009.json: Off‑screen, a fanatical goblin in your camp is building a shrine to the Absolute and leading a raucous celebration after goblins sacked a nearby tiefling den. One brawler in particular idolizes you, calls you "True Soul," and has offered a grisly looted lute as a trophy — when he presented it a strange symbol on your flesh glowed, suggesting a supernatural or cult resonance. Other companions and larger camp tensions (infected allies, temple/curse matters, nearby activities like Shadowheart’s pod or Lae'zel’s vigilance) may be present but aren’t part of this immediate moment. The excerpt shows the goblin chanting Absolute prayers as you step up to the makeshift shrine and touch your heart and head, with the mark on your flesh stirring in response.
- SCL_Drider_Caravan_HalfOrcCaster.json: Player approaches Kansif (a stoic, honourable male half-orc) and Brawler Vez (a mouthy female goblin) after clearing a checkpoint and entering their camp in the Shadowcurse. They two Absolute cultists assume you're a True Soul sent by Minthara (which may or may not be true) and will ask if you brought the lyre needed to summon their guide through the darkness. If you have, you can play it and the drider will emerge. If you haven't, they can tell you where to find it.
- GOB_Orpheus_VoiceOfAbsolute_ShadowheartHasBox.json: The party hears the voice of the Absolute, faint, in their minds.Shadowheart takes out the infernal puzzle box, it glows brighter and brighter, and then the voice stops. Player avatar questions Shadowheart about the box. If the player is not aware of Shadowheart being a Shar worshipper, then they can discover this here, if she tells them about the artefact.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Goblin Booyahg: Let the Absolute hear your prayers. Let the blood of Her enemies flow over you! (node 18)
- Narrator: *A strange symbol glows, marked on their flesh, and something within you stirs in response.* (node 30)
- Player: Step up to the shrine, touching your fingers to your heart and your head. (node 3)

context: Off‑screen, a fanatical goblin in your camp has been building a makeshift shrine to the Absolute and leading a rowdy celebration after goblins sacked a nearby tiefling den. One goblin brawler in particular idolizes you, calling you the "True Soul" and even offered a grisly looted lute as a trophy; when the shrine ritual was presented earlier, a strange symbol on your flesh glowed, implying a supernatural resonance with the cult. In this moment the goblin is chanting Absolute prayers at the shrine while you step up and touch your fingers to your heart and head, which stirs the mark on you. Other companion tensions and nearby matters (infected allies, temple/curse business, or Shadowheart’s box) may be happening elsewhere in camp but aren’t part of this immediate exchange.
